Once the sprout displays are accepted, we'll describe the redwood and tanoak
height patterns across treatments and time in a 1–1.5-page Results subsection.
This should add the sprout-development evidence to the regeneration story.
We'll consider combining it with RT01 if a shared display and message make the
two results easier to follow together.

The [initial RD03 review](task-rd03.qmd#rd03-interpretation) identifies a
model/prose mismatch in the thesis and distinguishes tallest-clump height from
growth of an individually tracked stem. Model selection and display acceptance
remain pending. We'll draft from the eventual verified estimates and contrasts,
with explicit period and site weighting, rather than inherit the thesis's
parallel-response or significance claims.

The [RD03 Phase One audit](task-rd03.qmd#rd03-phase-one) now traces the recorded
cohort to the workbook and recovers its redwood residual-tree indicator. Original
enrollment and mortality history remain unavailable; model fitting and any
generalization beyond the selected recorded clumps still require review.
